title: Diamond DA40 180 — Normal Operating Procedures
description: Normal operating procedures for the Diamond DA40 with 180-hp Lycoming IO-360 engine and constant-speed propeller. Covers preflight walk-around through shutdown and securing. Contains no numeric limitations; all speeds, fuel quantities, power settings, and performance values must be obtained from the specific aircraft POH/AFM. Accounts for the DA40's composite construction, T-tail, canopy-style entry door, left/right/both fuel selector, sidestick controls, and constant-speed propeller. G1000 glass panel is common on this type; verify avionics items against the specific aircraft configuration.

source.notes: No manufacturer document consulted. Written from general familiarity with the Diamond DA40 type, Lycoming IO-360 fuel-injected engine, and constant-speed propeller operations.

known_issues.description: Contains no airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities, or other numeric limitations — all such values must come from the specific aircraft POH/AFM.
Equipment and avionics vary across DA40 production. Verify all items against the specific aircraft POH, supplements, and installed equipment before use.

rights.notes: Diamond Aircraft POH/AFM remains under copyright. This file is independently authored and does not reproduce the wording or item selection of any manufacturer document.

items.text: Aircraft documents (ARROW) — airworthiness certificate, registration, radio station license, operating handbook/AFM, weight-and-balance data

items.response: NO DELAMINATION, CRACKS, OR IMPACT DAMAGE

items.text: Nose section — composite skin for impact damage or cracks
Engine cowling — all latches and fasteners
Engine oil level — dipstick; within acceptable operating range per POH
items.response: WITHIN RANGE; CAP REINSTALLED AND SECURE
